title: 给编码代理补上评审、浏览器与协议层
opening: 今天榜单几乎被“怎么让编码代理更好用”占满：Plannotator 把代理产出的计划、HTML 和 diff 变成可批注的评审面，Chrome DevTools MCP 则让代理直接操作真实浏览器。前者补的是人机来回，后者补的是代理的眼睛和手。

projects.name: backnotprop/plannotator
projects.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

Review diffs and PRs. Send feedback to your agent.                         Plannotator Inbox · Official site · Code Review · Visual HTML Skills · Herdr Annotate · (Legacy) Plan Mode Plannotator **⭐️ NEW:** Plannotator Inbox is the missing review layer between you and multi-agent work. It surfaces decisions, prototypes, variations, plans, and everything you need to stay in the loop. Works with all coding agents and personal assistants. Plannotator Inbox also works with personal assistants (Grok Bot, Muse, Hermes, OpenClaw). **It plugs directly into your agent** through plugins, hooks and commands. projects.summary: 本地浏览器里的代理评审台，把计划、HTML 产物和代码 diff 摊开批注，一键把反馈送回代理。
projects.problem: 代理提出方案或改完代码后，人往往只能在终端里读文本、再手打反馈。它通过插件和钩子把产物拉到浏览器里标记、评论，适合多代理并行时集中处理决策和 PR 评审；局限是依赖各代理的接入方式，且浏览器端暴露内容需注意隐私。

projects.name: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
projects.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
projects.readmeExcerpt: Modern Web Guidance (Source) This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents. **Modern Web Guidance** is a set of skills that embed web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data directly into your coding agents. It helps to steer your coding agents away from legacy patterns, and instead toward solutions that harness the power and capabilities of the modern web platform. See CONTRIBUTING.md and GOVERNANCE.md for how we work on the project and orientation of the codebase. *Stewarded by the Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and MDN teams, alongside the web development community.* Documentation · Eval Dashboard · Source Code · Report an Issue Quickstart This command runs an interactive wizard to install Modern Web Guidance. See Alternative Installation Methods below. Try it out (without installing) Why? Coding agents often default to older patterns because LLM training data contains vast amounts of legacy code. This often leads them to generate bloated JavaScript for tasks that now have native, high-performance web platform solut
projects.summary: 把现代 Web 平台最佳实践和兼容数据做成代理技能，专门纠正模型爱写旧模式的老毛病。
projects.problem: 编码代理的训练数据里堆满旧代码，容易为原生已支持的能力生成臃肿 JS。这套技能由 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 和 MDN 团队共同维护，直接嵌入代理工作流；目前是源仓库，重点在内容编写与评估，不是开箱即用的产品。

projects.name: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
projects.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Claude Trading Skills Claude Trading Skills started as a personal project to use AI to improve my own trading process. Claude Trading Skills is a Claude Skills-based trading workflow toolkit for time-constrained individual investors. It is designed for investors who use long-term investing, ETFs, and dividend stocks as their core, while using disciplined swing trading as a satellite strategy when market conditions are favorable. The goal is not to outsource buy/sell decisions to AI. The goal is to structure market review, risk management, trade planning, journaling, and continuous improvement. It is open source because the workflows, checklists, and review habits behind better trading decisions can improve through shared practice. This is not a signal service or a promise of profitability. It is a toolkit for traders who want to build a better decision process. The project follows a **first for self, open for others** stance: it is built first as a practical workflow the author uses, then shared openly for others who face similar constraints. 📖 **Documentation site:** **Project vision:** `PROJECT_VISION.md` 日本語版READMEは`README.ja.md`をご覧ください。 Disclaimer This repository is for educat
projects.summary: 面向个人投资者的 Claude 交易工作流技能包，管市场复盘、风险管理和交易日志，不替你做买卖决定。
projects.problem: 作者明确说目标不是让 AI 下单，而是把复盘、计划、记录这些容易偷懒的环节结构化。适合以 ETF 和股息股为主、偶尔波段的人；但它是流程工具，不提供信号，也不承诺收益，README 自带免责声明。

projects.name: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp

Both give your AI coding assistant access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis. projects.summary: 把 Chrome DevTools 包成 MCP 服务器和 CLI，让编码代理能录制性能 trace、查网络请求和控制实时浏览器。
projects.problem: 代理调试前端时常靠猜，这个项目让它直接读控制台、截图、分析网络并做可靠自动化。功能很实在，但 README 也提醒：它会把浏览器实例内容暴露给 MCP 客户端，共享敏感数据的环境要谨慎。

projects.name: alibaba/open-code-review
projects.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
projects.readmeExcerpt: OpenCodeReview English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Русский What is Open Code Review? Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, `ocr scan` reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff. Visit the official website for more details. projects.summary: 阿里内部打磨两年的 AI 代码评审 CLI，确定性流水线加 LLM Agent，输出行级评论。
projects.problem: 它不只读 diff，还能让代理翻全文、搜代码库、看其他改动文件来补上下文，适合仓库级评审和审计陌生代码。内置多语言规则集覆盖 NPE、线程安全、XSS 等；基准称同模型下比通用代理精度更高、token 消耗约九分之一，但需自配模型端点。

projects.problem: 卖点是开箱即用的 Agentic 能力：Auto-Memory、Skills、SubAgents、MCP 首会话就能用，并支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 和本地模型运行时切换。项目自称正用自身代理提 issue、跑测试，这种自举值得观察，但也意味着迭代节奏可能很猛。

projects.summary: 一个轻量的事件式协议，标准化 AI 代理如何把执行过程流向前端应用并接收用户输入。
projects.problem: 代理后端按约 16 种标准事件类型发消息，前端用少量兼容输入回传，中间件负责适配 SSE 等不同传输。它解决的是代理与 UI 之间各写各的胶水代码问题；协议本身不绑定框架，价值取决于有多少集成方跟进。

projects.name: ashhart/TensorFold
projects.description: LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan.
projects.readmeExcerpt: TensorFold TensorFold serves language models from a Zig binary on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs. The engine reads checkpoints, tokenizes requests and runs Metal or CUDA kernels directly. Serving needs no Python or MLX installation. Building with a coding agent? Have it load the contributor skill before it writes any code. Contributing with agents Please use Agent Traffic Control before editing TensorFold so contributors and agents can avoid duplicate work and conflicting changes. Check the live agent radar before choosing an issue and follow CONTRIBUTING.md and the ATC contributor instructions. Install or upgrade ATC to 0.9.4 or later, then run from an updated TensorFold clone: Replace `ISSUE` with the issue number and claim only after a complete check says the work is free. TensorFold enables automatic public check-ins: a successful new claim starts an anonymous session on the radar and returns its `session` number. Keep that number instead of starting a duplicate session. For work already yours, start a session with `atc start ISSUE --json`. Add `--github-name` to `claim` or `start` only if you want your verified GitHub name shown; `--local` keeps a new session on your machine. T
projects.summary: 用 Zig 写的 LLM 推理引擎，直接在 Apple Silicon 和 NVIDIA GPU 上跑 Metal 或 CUDA 内核。
projects.problem: 它读 checkpoint、分词、跑内核一条龙，服务时不需要 Python 或 MLX 环境，对想减少运行时依赖的人有吸引力。项目还引入 Agent Traffic Control 来协调代理贡献者避免重复劳动，这种协作方式本身比引擎更少见；成熟度仍需观察。

projects.summary: 让编码代理“像穴居人说话”的提示技能加代理，号称靠少读少写砍掉大量 token。
projects.problem: 思路是压缩代理的输入输出表达，同时保持代码精确，README 列了与 Claude Code、Codex 的对比数据，并称被 Adobe Research 引用、JetBrains 做过 A/B。争议点也明显：省 token 的代价是表达退化，复杂任务里是否稳定，需要自己拿任务验证。

closing: 今天最值得看的是代理工具开始分层：有人做评审面，有人做浏览器接口，有人做交互协议。省 token 的噱头很响，但真正决定代理好不好用的，还是这些中间层是否扎实。
